text:
Diego (Recruiter): New hire Amina O starting Mon 9am PT. US citizen, currently in London for three weeks; asking to start remotely.
Sofia (People Ops): Quick check  can we accept a UK notary/rep for I-9 verification?
Global HR Bot: I-9 rule reminder: must be completed within 3 business days of start. Company can designate an authorized representative but assumes liability. E-Verify requires US-based verification or approved vendor.
Legal (Contracting): We can authorize a UK notary as rep but E-Verify may not complete remotely. If E-Verify applies (US citizen), it's safer to do in-person in the US or via our approved vendor.
Diego (Recruiter): Candidate is US citizen; can return in 10 days but wants to start earlier.
Sofia (People Ops): Options: 1) delay start until in-person I-9, 2) allow conditional/limited access start pending in-person I-9 within X days, 3) attempt approved international vendor (higher risk). Thoughts?
Payroll (Ops): Note: payroll needs W-4 + SSN for first run. If I-9 incomplete, we can delay direct deposit and issue a one-time check after verification; taxes default if W-4 missing.
Diego (Recruiter): Candidate ok with limited access and signing acknowledgement. Concerned about equipment/security if we send laptop overseas.
Sofia (People Ops): We can ship device to UK but lock admin rights until I-9 cleared; or allow day-1 on personal device under strict VPN/MDM with no production access. Offer equipment stipend as alternative.
Legal (Contracting): Prepare a conditional employment acknowledgement outlining limited access, E-Verify note, and potential status changes if E-Verify fails. Candidate must sign before start.
Global HR Bot: Background vendor flagged overseas verification; some vendors require in-person identity confirmation.
Diego (Recruiter): Candidate can upload passport + US DL and UK utility bill; vendor still requests in-person check.
Sofia (People Ops): Plan: approve conditional start with signed acknowledgement; require W-4 before payroll cutoff; schedule in-person I-9 within 10 days of start; limit system access until verification. I'll create HR ticket and update calendar invite.
Diego (Recruiter): Candidate agreed, signed acknowledgement, and scheduled in-person I-9 in 10 days. I'll post confirmation once all docs uploaded.
Payroll (Ops): We'll flag payroll to expect delayed deposit and can issue check after verification if needed.
Sofia (People Ops): Closing loop  I'll own the ticket HR-2054 and escalate to Legal if vendor blocks. Thanks everyone.
